instruction.text: Read the following text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Diane looked down from the top of the wall. Her legs were shaking and her palms had started to sweat. The climbing instructor called to her and told her that she was tied to a rope, so she was safe. However, Diane still couldn’t bring herself to let go of the wall. She thought about how much it would hurt to fall from such a height.

atoms.a: Where do you think Diane is?
b: ++at the top of a climbing wall

atoms.a: Why do you think Diane’s palms became sweaty?
b: she wanted to stay on the wall

atoms.a: Why did she not want to climb down?
b: there was not an instructor present
